summary_md: **Daniel van Strien ([@vanstriendaniel](https://x.com/vanstriendaniel/status/2116474636489924987))** built a Hugging Face Space that searches 1,864 public-domain Prelinger films by caption, then uses Liquid AI's **d1-2B** decision model to check three frames per clip against a yes/no question and jump to matching moments ([prelinger-moments-space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/davanstrien/prelinger-moments-space)).

referenced_urls.title: Prelinger moments - a Hugging Face Space by davanstrien

relevance: Small decision model for video moment search.

media.description: Search UI over public-domain Prelinger films: query "people wearing costume" with a yes/no follow-up question, answered by a small decision model on ZeroGPU.
Search result from a 1941 amateur film of a Mardi Gras parade, with timestamped moments such as a child in a clown costume waving.
